query:
SELECT wowReportStatus, wowReportError, 
  JSON_KEYS(wowReportJson) as json_keys,
  LEFT(wowReportPdfUrl, 80) as pdf_url,
  updatedAt
FROM analysis_reports
WHERE clientId = 1149902
LIMIT 1;
